# Slavery and Scripture Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L11 - Slavery and Scripture

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Slavery and Scripture.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Exodus 21:1-11; Philemon; 1 Timothy 1:8-11

## Big idea

Biblical slavery texts span different institutions and trajectories and must not be used to sanitise modern racial chattel slavery.

## Guardrails

Differentiate ancient servitude institutions from modern racial chattel slavery while refusing to sanitize exploitation in either context. | Do not claim the Bible's presence of slavery regulation equals moral endorsement of slavery as an ideal.
